name: @egon-orm/example-runtime
description: The runtime matrix (step 21): one round trip against Postgres and SQLite from an ES module, from CommonJS through require(), and from esbuild bundles of both; run on Node 22 and 24, and on Bun (Postgres only).

scripts.check: node esm.mjs && node cjs.cjs && node bundle.mjs
